resources.string: On the device you wish to evaluate, go to\n Settings/DeviceDiagnostics/Evaluated Device\n Follow the prompts on that device.

You will now be shown a series of screens. Study each on and look for defects. Once you are satisfied, touch the screen to move to the next one. At the end, you will be asked if the screens look unblemished.
Please select the option below that best matches the condition of the screen.

You will now be shown a red screen.
 
 Rub your finger over the screen until the screen is entirely white. If you are unable to turn part of the screen white, short tap the screen to indicate that the touch sensor is not fully working.
 
 If you wish, you can back swipe from the report screen and continue the test from where you left off.
Please scan this QR code on the trusted device. After you have scanned it, you may press Done on this device.
